name: EvSpace-C
description: Reproducibility artifact for “EvSpace-C: A Harm-Calibrated Robustness Benchmark for Event-Camera Perception in Space.” This release contains corruption injectors, task estimators, evaluation and analysis code, sequence manifests, derived results, figure-generation and verification scripts, supplementary appendices, and benchmark documentation. Raw source datasets are not redistributed. Acquisition instructions and source-specific licensing information are provided in the package. Consult LICENSE and LICENSES.md for component-specific terms, including the separately identified e-STURT-derived results. Start with README.txt and artifact/README.md. The supplied verification workflow checks consistency of the released results without downloading the raw datasets; full experimental reproduction requires obtaining the source datasets and following the documented procedures.
